title: Membership EXISTS / IN stays a SubPlan
issue: EXISTS/IN over the membership table inside a policy lives in rte->securityQuals, which pull_up_sublinks does not touch: no semi-join, no join reordering, bad estimates.
symptom: naive_rls: Filter with (hashed) SubPlan on a Seq Scan or full index walk; count(*) and latest-N are O(table) not O(visible rows).

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.documents (100 docs per org, scale/20 users)
